replications.outcomeQuote: Here we attempted to replicate previously reported links between sex differences in mate preferences and country-level measures of gender inequality [...]. Although women preferred mates with good earning capacity more than men did and men preferred physically attractive mates more than women did, we found little evidence that these sex differences were smaller in countries with greater gender equality.
